clusters.headline: Search Continues After Fatal Fire At PT Fonusa Agung Mulia Factory
aiSummaryBullets: Six bodies have been recovered from the site of a major blaze at the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia candy factory in Cikande, Banten.
Banten Regional Police report that approximately 50 employees remain unaccounted for following the incident.

clusters.headline: Three Dead And Dozens Missing Following Indonesia Factory Fire
aiSummaryBullets: A fire at a confectionery factory in Banten province resulted in three confirmed deaths and 36 people currently missing.
Emergency rescue crews have successfully retrieved 15 individuals, with four of those survivors currently receiving medical treatment.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Provinces Announce Varied 2027 Minimum Wage Increases
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta has set its 2027 provincial minimum wage at Rp6.1 million, a 7.1 percent increase that has drawn comparisons to Bekasi's higher rate.
Several regions have finalized their 2027 rates, including significant percentage hikes reported in Central Java, Bali, and Yogyakarta.

clusters.headline: Aprilia Racing Wins 2026 MotoGP Title After Sprint Race In Portugal
aiSummaryBullets: Aprilia Racing officially secured the 2026 MotoGP Team World Championship title in Portimao.
Marco Bezzecchi emerged victorious in the sprint race held at the Portuguese circuit.

clusters.headline: Drug Cartel Boss El Chapo Isidro Arrested Amid Deadly Shootout
aiSummaryBullets: Mexican cartel figure Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, also known as El Chapo Isidro, has been captured.
The arrest operation in the state of Sinaloa resulted in at least 11 deaths.

clusters.headline: Kapolri Suyudi Ario Seto Reports 600 Tons Of Seized Narcotics
aiSummaryBullets: National Police Chief General Suyudi Ario Seto reported the seizure of 600 tons of narcotics over a two-month period.
The ongoing operation follows the recent disruption of an international drug syndicate operating through a scrap metal business.

clusters.headline: Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Ario Seto Mutasi 704 Personel Kepolisian
aiSummaryBullets: Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Ario Seto memutasi 704 perwira tinggi dan menengah dalam sebuah langkah rotasi skala besar.
Pergantian posisi mencakup enam jabatan Kepala Kepolisian Daerah dan sejumlah Wakil Kepala Kepolisian Daerah.

clusters.headline: Indonesia And European Union Formally Sign The IEU-CEPA Agreement
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia and the European Union have officially signed the IEU-CEPA and IPA agreements to expand trade and investment.
The agreement follows a decade of negotiations and is expected to become operational by the beginning of 2027.

clusters.headline: Public Figures And Academics Back Sufmi Dasco For Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Sufmi Dasco Ahmad is receiving increasing support from political allies and academics for the position of Vice President.
Endorsers highlight his political experience, problem-solving skills, and long-term loyalty to President Prabowo Subianto as primary credentials.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto To Submit Two VP Candidates To MPR On Nov 25
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto is scheduled to present two vice presidential candidates to the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) on November 25.
The MPR has established a verification team divided into three working groups to evaluate the requirements of the candidates.

clusters.headline: Military Tensions Surge Between The United States And Iran Escalates
aiSummaryBullets: Iran warns of further retaliation if the United States continues military operations against Tehran.
Reports indicate that intelligence officials from Israel have urged the United States to conduct joint strikes against Iran.

clusters.headline: DPD RI Chair Sultan Najamudin Proposes Multiple Vice Presidents
aiSummaryBullets: Sultan Najamudin, Chair of the DPD RI, proposed that Indonesia consider having more than one vice president in the future.
The proposal is intended to spark open national dialogue regarding the structure of the Indonesian executive leadership.

clusters.headline: Slamet Uliandi, Ahrie Sonta, and Eko Hadi Transferred In Wiretap Case
aiSummaryBullets: Irjen Slamet Uliandi, Ahrie Sonta, and Eko Hadi were reassigned to the Bareskrim Polri's Yanma division.
The officials are implicated in an ongoing investigation regarding the alleged wiretapping of President Prabowo.

clusters.headline: Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Ario Seto Rotasi Pejabat Polda Metro Jaya
aiSummaryBullets: National Police Chief General Suyudi Ario Seto rotated key officials and regional police chiefs at Polda Metro Jaya.
The rotation was formalized through three official telegrams issued on November 20, 2026.

clusters.headline: Mount Semeru And Mount Ibu Erupt Launching Volcanic Ash Columns
aiSummaryBullets: Mount Semeru and Mount Ibu recorded near-simultaneous eruptions on Saturday.
Volcanic ash columns from the events reached heights of up to 400 meters.

clusters.headline: Kapolri Reassigns Three Generals Suspected In Prabowo Wiretapping
aiSummaryBullets: National Police Chief General Suyudi Ario Seto reassigned three high-ranking police officers currently under investigation.
The suspects are linked to allegations of illegal wiretapping targeting President Prabowo Subianto and other prominent figures.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Traffic Adjustments For Guns N' Roses Concert At GBK
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta authorities have implemented traffic diversions and designated 11 parking locations around the Gelora Bung Karno stadium for the concert.
Public transport providers including Transjakarta and MRT have extended operational hours on select routes to assist attendees with travel.

clusters.headline: BMKG Issues Severe Weather Forecasts For Various Indonesian Regions
aiSummaryBullets: The BMKG has issued forecasts for heavy rainfall and potential thunderstorms across several Indonesian regions through the weekend.
Most areas in the Jabodetabek region are expected to experience light rain, while specific districts face warnings for extreme weather events.

clusters.headline: Zulkifli Hasan Oversees Food Aid Distribution And Security Efforts
aiSummaryBullets: Coordinating Minister for Food Zulkifli Hasan is overseeing rice aid distribution in areas including Banyuwangi.
The government aims to strengthen village-level food security through the development of 40,000 thematic protein zones.

clusters.headline: Listyo Sigit and Ahrie Sonta to Testify in Alleged Treason Case
aiSummaryBullets: Former police chief Listyo Sigit and Irjen Ahrie Sonta will provide testimony in an ongoing investigation concerning alleged treason.
The treason inquiry developed from a broader investigation into illegal wiretapping incidents involving President Prabowo Subianto.
